mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns fail to outperform a 5% benchmark in 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by 1% or more over the same period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rates above 4.0% triggers investor concerns about labor market weakening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite UNRATE exceeding 4.0% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in GDP demand (GDPC1) creates conflicting signals, but the market interprets this as a late-cycle expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS falls and GDPC1 rises concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the CPIAUCSL index above 315 signals accelerating inflation, prompting market anticipation of higher interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite CPIAUCSL exceeding 315 for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) and consumer demand (HOUST) both increasing strongly indicate robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases by 5% and HOUST increases by 10% from prior month
failure_condition: 60-day returns fail to exceed a 2% benchmark when both INDPRO and HOUST rise as specified.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects expanding supply capacity, which positively impacts future earnings and S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns do not rise above 1% when INDPRO shows a 2% monthly increase.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of elevated federal funds rates above 5.5%, investors anticipate higher inflation and tighter policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive when FEDFUNDS stays above 5.5% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Rising labor demand (PAYEMS) and strong GDP demand (GDPC1) create a synergistic effect, driving immediate positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by 5% and GDPC1 increases by 3% from prior month
failure_condition: 5-day returns fail to exceed 1% when both PAYEMS and GDPC1 rise as specified.
